events.event_title: Israeli military admit to posting AI photo of Lebanese journalist it killed
events.justification: The manipulation of a deceased journalist's image by the Israeli military to falsely label him as a terrorist is a serious violation of press freedom and human dignity. | The manipulation of a deceased journalist's image by the Israeli military to falsely label him as a terrorist is a serious violation of press freedom and human dignity. This action undermines trust in media and contributes to the erosion of ethical standards in conflict reporting.
